pr_title: Set default namespace in Event.Regarding if namespace is empty

/kind bug

If it might help to track this down: ~~I've got a local Kubernetes v1.21 cluster in which -- after upgrade to Kubernetes v1.22 -- `kube-proxy` pod fails to reach the 'ready' state due to the empty/unset namespace issue (reproducible on each of two attempts to upgrade followed by rollback to v1.21)~~.  If there are any debugging steps or configuration settings to check that'd help with investigation, let me know and I'll take a look.

Sorry -- I think I got my wires crossed due to an unrelated cluster networking issue that I was debugging in the same cluster.

To clarify: this issue does _not_ prevent `kube-proxy` pods from reaching the 'ready' state, but the following error message does appear in their pod logs:

